from pathlib import Path
import collections, hashlib, json, sys
import jsonschema
base=Path('tmp/physics-native-integration-k3k6-20261115/native-d/round-b')
campaign=json.loads((base/'description-review-campaign.json').read_text())
review_input=json.loads((base/'description-review-input.json').read_text())
bundle=json.loads((base/'review-bundle-manifest.json').read_text())
schema_path=base/'contracts/goal-description-review-record.schema.json'
schema=json.loads(schema_path.read_text())
batch_paths=sorted((base/'batches').glob('*.input.jsonl'))
rows=[json.loads(line) for f in batch_paths for line in f.read_text().splitlines() if line.strip()]
run_id='physics-k3k6-current13-20261115-first-pass-b'
result_path=base/'results'/f'{run_id}.batch-001.records.jsonl'
raw=result_path.read_bytes()
records=[json.loads(line) for line in raw.decode().splitlines() if line.strip()]
jsonschema.Draft202012Validator.check_schema(schema)
validator=jsonschema.Draft202012Validator(schema)
for n,record in enumerate(records,1):
    errors=list(validator.iter_errors(record))
    assert not errors, [(n,list(e.path),e.message) for e in errors]
assert raw.endswith(b'\n')
assert len(batch_paths)==1
assert len(records)==len(rows)==campaign['goalCount']==review_input['goalCount']==bundle['selectedGoalCount']==13
expected_ids=campaign['batches'][0]['goalIds']
assert [r['goalId'] for r in records]==expected_ids==[g['goalId'] for g in review_input['goals']]==[g['goalId'] for g in bundle['goals']]
assert [r['ordinal'] for r in rows]==list(range(1,14))
assert len({r['recordId'] for r in records})==13
for key in ['bundleFingerprint','bookDigest','reviewInputFingerprint']:
    assert campaign[key]==review_input[key]
assert bundle['bundleFingerprint']==campaign['bundleFingerprint']
assert bundle['bookModelDigest']==campaign['bookDigest']
def digest(path):
    return 'sha256:'+hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
assert digest(schema_path)==campaign['recordSchemaDigest']==campaign['batches'][0]['recordSchemaDigest']
assert digest(base/'prompt.md')==campaign['promptFingerprint']==bundle['promptFingerprint']
assert digest(base/'criteria.md')==campaign['criteriaFingerprint']==bundle['criteriaFingerprint']
bound_keys=['goalId','goalFingerprint','pageFingerprint','currentTitleDe','currentTitleEn','currentDescriptionDe','currentDescriptionEn']
for row,record,goal,manifest_goal in zip(rows,records,review_input['goals'],bundle['goals']):
    assert row['batchGoalIds']==expected_ids
    assert row['batchId']==campaign['batches'][0]['batchId']
    assert row['recordSchemaDigest']==campaign['recordSchemaDigest']
    assert row['reviewInputFingerprint']==campaign['reviewInputFingerprint']
    assert row['goal']==goal
    assert record['runId']==run_id
    assert record['recordId']==run_id+'.'+goal['goalId']
    assert record['campaignId']==campaign['campaignId']
    assert record['roundId']==campaign['roundId']==run_id
    for key in ['bundleFingerprint','bookDigest']:
        assert record[key]==row[key]==campaign[key]
    for key in bound_keys:
        assert record[key]==goal[key]
    for key in ['goalId','goalFingerprint','pageFingerprint']:
        assert record[key]==manifest_goal[key]
    assert record['recordStatus']=='candidate'
    assert record['reviewAuthority']=='ai_candidate'
    assert record['evidenceProfileContract']=='positive-understanding-evidence-v2'
    assert len(record['understandingEvidence'])==6
fields=[value for r in records for value in r['understandingEvidence'].values()]
assert len(set(fields))==len(fields)==78
input_paths=[
    base/'prompt.md',base/'criteria.md',base/'description-review-campaign.json',
    base/'review-bundle-manifest.json',base/'description-review-input.json',schema_path,*batch_paths
]
report={
    'runId':run_id,
    'reviewer':'reviewer-b',
    'recordStatus':'candidate',
    'reviewAuthority':'ai_candidate',
    'resultPath':str(result_path),
    'recordCount':len(records),
    'decisionCounts':{k:sum(r['decision']==k for r in records) for k in ['keep','revise','split_review','block']},
    'evidenceProfileRecommendationCounts':dict(collections.Counter(r['evidenceProfileRecommendation'] for r in records)),
    'checks':{

        'exactCampaignBatchAndRunBindings':True,

        'batchGoalsEqualBoundReviewInputGoals':True,
        'promptCriteriaAndSchemaRawDigestBindings':True,
        'allRecordsCandidateAiCandidate':True,
        'sixSpecificBilingualEvidenceFieldsPerGoal':True,
        'noDuplicateEvidenceFields':True,
        'replacementFieldsOnlyForRevise':True,
        'trailingNewlinePresent':True
    },
    'inputFileRawSha256':{str(p):digest(p) for p in input_paths},
    'resultFileRawSha256':digest(result_path),
